notablePrerequisites:
Thraben Doomsayer does not have summoning sickness.
"Pirate" chosen with Conspiracy.
description:
Activate Thraben Doomsayer by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Human creature token.
When the Human enters the battlefield as a Pirate due to Conspiracy, Coercive Recruiter triggers, untapping Thraben Doomsayer.
Repeat.
